columns.db_mb: sqlite database size in MB at measurement time
columns.mrr: MRR on the row's evaluation split
columns.mv: multi-vector marker: true = measured against the embeddings_mv store (FR-005), false = single-vector default

row_shape.contract: Additive columns only: guards assert set(row) >= these keys, so later tasks may add columns but never remove or retype them (D-008 consequences; TC-028). ds-v2 rows additionally carry 'corpus': a per-corpus label from dataset.families.ds-v2.corpora or 'macro-average'.
